conclusions.observed_mechanism: Nearly tied candidate scores change the winner under the unchanged hard-argmax rule; candidate Z values and refined support remain stable. Exact upstream operator responsible was not isolated.
conclusions.observation_timing: Plain passes have no observation wrapper. Observed passes call original argmax exactly once and return its unmodified result, then copy candidate values to CPU; those copies synchronize CUDA.
conclusions.scope: Two flagged images, three plain and three observed passes in each of two actual runtimes; this is not a replacement for the complete 1226 strict acceptance.
